copy_config_location.description: Whether to copy config files to the config directory (for portable setups).

daemon_port.description: Port for the Deluge daemon to listen on (typically 58846).

dht_bootstrap_node.description: DHT bootstrap node in host:port format (e.g., 'router.utorrent.com:6881').

enable_peer_exchange.description: Enable Peer Exchange (PEX) for improved peer discovery.

listen_interfaces.description: Network interfaces to bind for incoming BitTorrent connections (format: 'host:port').

listen_port.description: Port to listen on for incoming BitTorrent traffic (must match listen_interfaces if specified separately).

log_append.description: Append to log files instead of overwriting them.

log_console_level.description: Logging level for console output (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

log_filename.description: Path to the log file (e.g., '/var/log/deluged/deluged.log'). If null, no file logging.

max_active_downloading.description: Maximum number of torrents allowed to be actively downloading at once.

max_active_limit.description: Maximum number of active torrents (download, seeding, or checking).

max_active_seeding.description: Maximum number of torrents allowed to be actively seeding at once.

max_connections_global.description: Maximum total number of connections across all torrents.

max_connections_per_second.description: Maximum new connections per second per torrent.

max_download_speed_per_torrent.description: Maximum download speed (KB/s) per torrent. -1 means unlimited.

max_upload_speed_per_torrent.description: Maximum upload speed (KB/s) per torrent. -1 means unlimited.

max_upload_speed_global.description: Global maximum upload speed (KB/s). -1 means unlimited.

no_atime_to_file.description: Do not update access time (atime) on files written by Deluge.

random_port.description: Use a random port for incoming BitTorrent connections on each restart.

save_incomplete_to.description: Directory to save incomplete downloads to. If null, uses default temp location.

send_user_agent.description: Send a user agent string to peers.

share_ratio_limit.description: Share ratio limit before auto-seeding stops (0.0 disables ratio-based seed stopping).

seed_time_limit.description: Time (minutes) to seed a torrent before stopping. 0 disables time-based seed stopping.

seed_time_ratio_limit.description: Seed time ratio limit (uploaded time / download time). 0 disables.

seed_ranking_torrents.description: List of torrent IDs to give priority in seed ranking. Only used when seed_ranking_mode='seed_ranking'.

items.description: Torrent infohash or hash (20-byte hex string)

ssl_certfile.description: Path to SSL certificate file (for encrypted daemon connections).

ssl_keyfile.description: Path to SSL private key file (for encrypted daemon connections).

start_daemon.description: Start the Deluge daemon automatically on service startup.

transfer_data_to_file.description: Write data directly to files (instead of memory buffer). Recommended for large downloads.

upnp.description: Enable UPnP for automatic port mapping.

user.description: User account under which the daemon process runs (e.g., 'deluge').

webui_port.description: Port for the Deluge Web UI (if enabled via web plugin).

webui_ssl_certfile.description: SSL certificate file for the Web UI.

webui_ssl_keyfile.description: SSL private key file for the Web UI.

webui_password.description: Password for the Web UI (stored in hashed format).
